title: An inactive part with stock is still listed in Inventory Value
custom_preconds: • A tracked part with bins +5 and -2 (net 3) at this location.
custom_steps:
1. Reports > Inventory Value, today: search the part.
  2. In Inventory, deactivate the part (bulk Deactivate or part dialog Inactive).
  3. Re-run Inventory Value for today and search the part.
custom_expected:
Step 1:

  • Listed with Qty 3.00.

Step 3:

  • Still listed with Qty 3.00; totals unchanged by the deactivation.
